So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. This is resilient because unearned rewards are capped and eventually burned, so an attacker cannot bank on a runaway Sybil campaign paying off. Consider a nectar as the anchor of the cost.
